easy.title: Sum an array with reduce

points: `reduce` walks through the array and carries a running result from one item to the next.

easy.title: Check if a number is even

`=== 0` checks that the remainder is exactly 0, which is only true for even numbers.

easy.title: Greeting with a template string

medium.title: Debounce
medium.summary: Wraps a function so it only runs after calls have stopped for a given delay. This is common for search boxes and window resizing.
points: `timer` lives outside the returned function, so it remembers the pending timeout between calls (a closure).
`(...args)` collects whatever arguments the caller passes, so they can be forwarded later.
`clearTimeout(timer)` cancels the previous waiting call.
`setTimeout` then schedules `fn(...args)` after `delay` milliseconds, so only the last call in a quick burst actually runs.

medium.title: Count words
medium.summary: Counts how many words are in a sentence. The example prints 4.
points: `trim()` removes spaces from both ends of the text.
`split(/\s+/)` cuts the text wherever one or more whitespace characters appear. `/\s+/` is a regular expression.
`words.length` is the number of pieces, which is the word count.

medium.title: Filter adults
medium.summary: Keeps only the users who are 18 or older and prints them.
points: `users` is an array of objects, each with a `name` and an `age`.
`filter` builds a new array with only the items for which the function returns true.
`user.age >= 18` is the test, so Alex and Sam stay and John (17) is removed.

medium.title: Find the maximum

points: The `if` at the top is a guard: an empty array has no maximum, so it returns `null` early.

`set` removes the first key (`this.items.keys().next().value`), the oldest one, when the cache is full.

master.summary: Defines a `customers` table, an `orders` table linked to it, and an index.
points: `PRIMARY KEY` gives every row a unique id, and `AUTOINCREMENT` makes it count up automatically.
`NOT NULL` forbids empty values, and `UNIQUE` forbids duplicate emails.
`CHECK (total >= 0)` rejects negative totals, and `DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` fills in the creation time.
`FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)` links each order to a customer.
`CREATE INDEX` makes searching orders by `customer_id` faster.
